traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.summary: Replace one attack with a 15-foot cone or 30-foot line of your ancestry's damage: DEX save (DC 8 + CON modifier + proficiency bonus), 1d10 (2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at 11, 4d10 at 17), half on a success; uses equal to your proficiency bonus per Long Rest.
traits.text: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide (choose the shape each time). Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes 1d10 damage of the type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. This damage increases by 1d10 when you reach character levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10). You can use this Breath Weapon a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
traits.engine_note: Uses are tracked as the resource `breath_weapon` (spend with apply_runtime_change USE_RESOURCE); the GM resolves the area, the saves and the damage with resolve_check/apply_runtime_change.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.summary: Resistance to your ancestry's damage type.
traits.text: You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait.
traits.engine_note: Applied in the damage pipeline from the chosen ancestry.

traits.summary: Darkvision 60 feet.
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.summary: From character level 5: as a Bonus Action sprout spectral wings for 10 minutes (Fly Speed equal to your Speed); once per Long Rest.
traits.text: When you reach character level 5, you can channel draconic magic to give yourself temporary flight. As a Bonus Action, you sprout spectral wings on your back that last for 10 minutes or until you retract the wings (no action required) or have the Incapacitated condition. During that time, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Your wings appear to be made of the same energy as your Breath Weapon. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.
traits.engine_note: Uses are tracked as the resource `draconic_flight` from character level 5; the GM narrates the flight.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.summary: Choose a lineage: a level 1 benefit now, and a spell always prepared at character levels 3 and 5 (castable once per Long Rest without a slot). Choose INT, WIS or CHA as the spellcasting ability for these spells.
traits.text: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage. When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table. You always have that spell prepared. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.summary: Choose Forest Gnome (Minor Illusion; Speak with Animals castable proficiency-bonus times per Long Rest) or Rock Gnome (Mending and Prestidigitation; clockwork devices). Choose INT, WIS or CHA as the spellcasting ability.
traits.text: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose one of the following options; whichever one you choose, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage). Forest Gnome: You know the Minor Illusion cantrip. You also always have the Speak with Animals spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell. Rock Gnome: You know the Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips. In addition, you can spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP), such as a toy, fire starter, or music box, that produces one chosen Prestidigitation effect when activated with a touch as a Bonus Action. You can have three such devices at a time; each falls apart 8 hours after its creation or when you dismantle it.
traits.engine_note: Cantrips are known from level 1; Forest Gnome's Speak with Animals is always prepared with proficiency-bonus free casts per Long Rest. Rock Gnome clockwork devices are narrated by the GM.

payload.summary: Giant blood: big and strong with a giant-ancestry gift such as stone endurance; speed 35.

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.summary: Choose one supernatural boon from your giant ancestry; uses equal to your proficiency bonus per Long Rest.
traits.text: You are descended from Giants. Choose one of the following benefits - a supernatural boon from your ancestry; you can use the chosen benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. Cloud's Jaunt (Cloud Giant): As a Bonus Action, you magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Fire's Burn (Fire Giant): When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage to that target. Frost's Chill (Frost Giant): When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d6 Cold damage to that target and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Hill's Tumble (Hill Giant): When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can give that target the Prone condition. Stone's Endurance (Stone Giant): When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total. Storm's Thunder (Storm Giant): When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.
traits.engine_note: Uses are tracked as the resource `giant_ancestry`; the GM applies the chosen boon's effect with apply_runtime_change.

traits.name: Large Form

traits.text: Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action if you're in a big enough space. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet.
